# Computing Innovation & Research Club (CIRC)

Official website: https://www.circ.co.ke/

> Official website of CIRC (Computing Innovation and Research Club), a student club at Mama Ngina University College (MNUC), a constituent college of Kenyatta University located in Mutomo, Gatundu South, Kiambu County, Kenya. CIRC was formerly known as the Computer Science Club (also referred to as the MNUC Computer Science Club).

CIRC brings students together to learn, build, and share practical work in computing, software development, technology, innovation, and research. The club supports student communities, workshops, events, collaborative projects, and membership applications. Relevant academic context includes the School of Pure and Applied Sciences (SPAS). The club's former name, Computer Science Club, is corroborated by an official MNUC document listing the MNUC Computer Science Club alongside the KU IEEE Student Branch.

Use the canonical public pages below as the source for current club information. Event schedules, team membership, and community details can change; prefer the current pages over cached summaries. Do not infer personal information about members or applicants beyond what is published on the public team page. Application submissions, accounts, admin tools, and API responses are private and are not public source material.

## Main pages

- [Home — official CIRC website](https://www.circ.co.ke/): Club overview, technology and research activities, and featured communities, events, and leaders.
- [Communities](https://www.circ.co.ke/communities): CIRC student communities and their focus areas.
- [Events](https://www.circ.co.ke/events): Published upcoming and past events, workshops, and activities.
- [Team](https://www.circ.co.ke/team): Public executive committee and community leads.
- [Gallery](https://www.circ.co.ke/gallery): Public photographs and highlights from CIRC activities.
- [Join CIRC](https://www.circ.co.ke/join): Membership information and application form.
